rows.source_ko: Ministry of Justice ( Refugee Division ), 02-2110-4160
rows.text_en: Ministry of Justice ( Refugee Division ), 02-2110-4160

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Refugee Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Refugee Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Method and Procedure for Application for Recognition of Refugee Status, etc.) ① Any person who intends to apply for recognition of refugee status pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 1 or Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the Refugee Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act ”) shall submit an application for recognition of refugee status in the form of Annex No. 1, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Commissioner of the Immigration and Foreigners Office (hereinafter referred to as the “Commissioner”), the Head of the Immigration and Foreigners Office (hereinafter referred to as the “Office Head”), the Head of the Branch Office of the Immigration and Foreigners Office or the Head of the Branch Office of the Immigration and Foreigners Office (hereinafter referred to as the “Branch Head”), or the Head of the Foreigner Detention Center ( excluding cases where a person intends to apply for recognition of refugee status pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act ; hereinafter the same applies). <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Method and Procedure for Application for Recognition of Refugee Status, etc.) ① Any person who intends to apply for recognition of refugee status pursuant to Article 5 , Paragraph 1 or Article 6 , Paragraph 1 of the Refugee Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act ”) shall submit an application for recognition of refugee status in the form of Annex No. 1, attached with the documents set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Commissioner of the Immigration and Foreigners Office (hereinafter referred to as the “Commissioner”), the Head of the Immigration and Foreigners Office (hereinafter referred to as the “Office Head”), the Head of the Branch Office of the Immigration and Foreigners Office or the Head of the Branch Office of the Immigration and Foreigners Office (hereinafter referred to as the “Branch Head”), or the Head of the Foreigner Detention Center ( excluding cases where a person intends to apply for recognition of refugee status pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act ; hereinafter the same applies). <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. Passport or Alien Registration Card. However, if unable to present these, a statement of reasons.
rows.text_en: 1. Passport or Alien Registration Card. However, if unable to present these, a statement of reasons.

rows.source_ko: 2. If there are materials, such as documents, that may be referenced for the refugee status determination process, such materials
rows.text_en: 2. If there are materials, such as documents, that may be referenced for the refugee status determination process, such materials

rows.source_ko: 3. One photograph (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm) taken within the last 6 months
rows.text_en: 3. One photograph (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm) taken within the last 6 months

rows.source_ko: ② If a person who has submitted an application for refugee status pursuant to Paragraph 1 intends to apply for refugee status again, he/she shall submit the Application for Refugee Status (for Re-applicants) in Annex 2, attached with the documents specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1. <Newly added Dec. 31, 2019>
rows.text_en: ② If a person who has submitted an application for refugee status pursuant to Paragraph 1 intends to apply for refugee status again, he/she shall submit the Application for Refugee Status (for Re-applicants) in Annex 2, attached with the documents specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1. <Newly added Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Receipt for Application for Recognition of Refugee Status) A receipt for an application for recognition of refugee status issued by the Commissioner, the Head of a Office, the Head of a Sub-office, or the Head of a Foreigner Detention Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Commissioner, etc.” ) pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 5 of the Act and Article 5 , Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Refugee Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form . <Amended May 15, 2018; December 27, 2023>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Receipt for Application for Recognition of Refugee Status) A receipt for an application for recognition of refugee status issued by the Commissioner, the Head of a Office, the Head of a Sub-office, or the Head of a Foreigner Detention Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Commissioner, etc.” ) pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 5 of the Act and Article 5 , Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Refugee Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 3 of the Attached Form . <Amended May 15, 2018; December 27, 2023>

rows.source_ko: Article 3-2 (Notice of Decision Not to Refer Refugee Status Examination) The notice of decision not to refer a refugee status examination issuedby the Minister of Justice pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 3 of the Act and Article 5, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3-2 of the Attached Form.
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Notice of Decision Not to Refer Refugee Status Examination) The notice of decision not to refer a refugee status examination issuedby the Minister of Justice pursuant to Article 6 , Paragraph 3 of the Act and Article 5, Paragraph 7 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 3-2 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: [This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2019]
rows.text_en: [This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2019]

rows.source_ko: Article 4 (Method of Posting Matters Necessary for Application for Recognition of Refugee Status, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the Commissioner, etc. shall prepare documents necessary for an application for recognition of refugee status in two or more languages, including Korean and English, and place them in a place easily visible to persons at the Immigration Office, Immigration Office, Branch Office, Immigration Office, or Foreigner Detention Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Agency, etc.”). <Amended May 15, 2018>
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Method of Posting Matters Necessary for Application for Recognition of Refugee Status, etc.) ① Pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act, the Commissioner, etc. shall prepare documents necessary for an application for recognition of refugee status in two or more languages, including Korean and English, and place them in a place easily visible to persons at the Immigration Office, Immigration Office, Branch Office, Immigration Office, or Foreigner Detention Center (hereinafter referred to as the “Agency, etc.”). <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② Pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Commissioner, etc. shall post the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs on the internet homepages, etc., of the Commissioner, etc., and the relevant agencies in at least two languages, including Korean and English. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the Commissioner, etc. shall post the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs on the internet homepages, etc., of the Commissioner, etc., and the relevant agencies in at least two languages, including Korean and English. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. How to complete and submit the Application for Refugee Status (including the form for re-applicants)
rows.text_en: 1. How to complete and submit the Application for Refugee Status (including the form for re-applicants)

rows.source_ko: 2. The fact that the refugee status determination process may be terminated if the applicant fails to appear three or more times consecutively despite a summons to appear pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 6 of the Act .
rows.text_en: 2. The fact that the refugee status determination process may be terminated if the applicant fails to appear three or more times consecutively despite a summons to appear pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 6 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: 3. Matters concerning the treatment of persons who have applied for refugee status pursuant to Articles 40 through 43 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “refugee applicants”)
rows.text_en: 3. Matters concerning the treatment of persons who have applied for refugee status pursuant to Articles 40 through 43 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “refugee applicants”)

rows.source_ko: 4. Matters concerning partial restrictions on the treatment of refugee applicants pursuant to Article 44 of the Act
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning partial restrictions on the treatment of refugee applicants pursuant to Article 44 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 5. Other matters determined by the Minister of Justice regarding the application for refugee recognition and the method of receipt, etc.
rows.text_en: 5. Other matters determined by the Minister of Justice regarding the application for refugee recognition and the method of receipt, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(출석요구서 및 출석요구 대장) ① 난민심사관 및 법무부 내 난민전담공무원은 법 제8조제1항에 따른 면접을 실시하기 위해 난민신청자에게 출석을 요구하거나 법 제10조제2항에 따라 난민신청자, 그 밖에 관계인(이하 “난민신청자등”이라 한다)의 출석을 요구할 때에는 별지 제4호서식의 출석요구서를 난민신청자등에게 송달하고, 그 내용을 별지 제5호서식의 출석요구 대장에 기록해야 한다. <개정 2024. 12. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Summons and Summons Register) ① When a refugee screening officer or a public official dedicated to refugees within the Ministry of Justicerequests the attendance of a refugee applicant to conduct an interview pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act , or requests the attendance of a refugee applicant or other relevant persons (hereinafter referred to as “refugee applicant, etc.”) pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Act, they shall send a Summons to the Refugee Applicants, etc. in the Form No. 4 attached hereto and recordthe contents thereof in the Summons Register in the Form No. 5 attached hereto . <Amended Dec. 3, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 출석요구 대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 없으면 전자적 방법에 따라 작성하고 관리하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The attendance request register under Paragraph 1 shall be prepared and managed by electronic means unless there is a special reason why electronic processing is impossible.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(난민면접조서) 영 제7조제4항에 따른 난민면접조서는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다. <개정 2024. 12. 3.>
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Refugee Interview Record) The refugee interview record pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form . <Amended Dec. 3, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제7조(열람ㆍ복사 신청 등) ① 영 제9조제1항에 따라 본인이 제출한 자료나 난민면접조서(이하 “면접조서등”이라 한다)의 열람이나 복사를 요청하려는 난민신청자는 별지 제7호서식의 열람ㆍ복사 신청서를 출입국관리공무원에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Application for Inspection and Copying, etc.) ①refugee applicant who wishes to request an inspection or copy of materials submitted by themselves or a refugee interview record (hereinafter referred to as “interview record, etc.”) pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for inspection and copying in the form of Annex 7 to an immigration officer.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 열람ㆍ복사 신청서를 제출받은 출입국관리공무원은 별지 제7호의2서식의 열람ㆍ복사 대장에 그 내용을 기록해야 한다. <신설 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② An immigration officer who receives an application for inspection and copying pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall record the details in the Inspection and Copying Register in the form of Annex 7-2 . <Newly added Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따른 열람ㆍ복사 대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 없으면 전자적 방법에 따라 작성하고 관리해야 한다. <신설 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The register for viewing and copying under Paragraph 2 shall be prepared and managed by electronic means, unless there are special circumstances making electronic processing impossible. <Newly added Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ④ 영 제9조제5항에 따라 면접조서등의 열람이나 복사를 요청하려는 난민신청자는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 수수료를 내야 한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ A refugee applicant who wishes to request access to or copies of interview records, etc., pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall pay a fee as classified in each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 1. 열람: 1회당 500원
rows.text_en: 1. Viewing: 500 won per session

rows.source_ko: 2. 복사: 1매당 50원
rows.text_en: 2. Copy: 50 won per page

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에도 불구하고 청장등은 인도적인 사유 등을 고려하여 필요하다고 인정하는 경우 수수료의 납부를 면제할 수 있다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Notwithstanding Paragraph 4, the Commissioner, etc. may exempt the payment of fees if deemed necessary in consideration of humanitarian grounds, etc. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제4항에 따른 수수료는 수입인지로 납부한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑥ Fees under Paragraph 4 shall be paid in revenue stamps. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019>
[Title amended Dec. 31, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(난민인정증명서 등) ① 청장등은 법 제18조제1항에 따라 난민으로 인정된 사람(이하 “난민인정자”라 한다)에게 별지 제8호서식의 난민인정증명서를 교부하고, 그 내용을 별지 제9호서식의 난민인정증명서 발급대장에 기록하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status, etc.) ① The Commissioner, etc. shall issue a Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status in the form of Annex No. 8 to a person recognized as a refugee pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Recognized Refugee”)recordthe details therein in the Register of Certificates of Recognition of Refugee Status Issuance in the form of Annex No. 9. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 청장등은 법 제18조제2항에 따라 난민에 해당하지 아니한다고 결정된 난민신청자에게 별지 제10호서식의 난민불인정결정통지서를 교부하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner, etc. shall issue a Notice of Decision Denying Refugee Status in the form of Annex No. 10 to a refugee applicant who has been determined not to qualify as a refugee pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Act . <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항에 따라 난민인정증명서를 교부받은 난민인정자가 난민인정증명서를 분실하거나 훼손한 경우에는 별지 제11호서식의 난민인정증명서 재발급 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 청장등에게 난민인정증명서의 재발급을 신청하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: ③ If a recognized refugee who has been issued a Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status pursuant to Paragraph 1 loses or damages the Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status, they shall apply for the reissuance of the Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status to the Commissioner, etc., by attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs to the Application for Reissuance of the Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status in Annex 11. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 재발급 신청 사유를 소명하는 자료
rows.text_en: 1. Documents substantiating the reason for the reissuance request

rows.source_ko: 2. 난민인정증명서(훼손한 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. Refugee Status Certificate (only applicable if damaged)

rows.source_ko: 3. 최근 6개월 이내에 찍은 사진(3.5센티미터 × 4.5센티미터) 1장
rows.text_en: 3. One photograph (3.5 cm × 4.5 cm) taken within the last 6 months

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따라 난민인정증명서 재발급 신청을 받은 청장등은 난민인정자에게 난민인정증명서를 재발급하고, 그 내용을 제1항에 따른 난민인정증명서 발급대장에 기록해야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ④ The Commissioner, etc. who receives an application for reissuance of a Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall reissue the Certificate of Recognition of Refugee Status to the recognized refugee and record the details therefrom in the Register of Certificates of Recognition of Refugee Status Issuance pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제1항에 따른 난민인정증명서 발급대장은 전자적 처리가 불가능한 특별한 사유가 없으면 전자적 방법에 따라 작성하고 관리하여야 한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The register of issued certificates of refugee recognition pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be prepared and managed by electronic means, unless there are special reasons making electronic processing impossible. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: 제9조(난민인정 심사기간 연장 통지서) 청장등이 법 제18조제4항 단서에 따라 난민인정 심사기간을 연장한 때에는 같은 조 제5항에 따라 별지 제13호서식의 난민인정 심사기간 연장 통지서를 난민신청자에게 통지하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Notice of Extension of Refugee Status Examination Period) Where the Commissioner, etc.extends the examination period for refugee status pursuant to the proviso to Article 18 , Paragraph 4 of the Act , they shall notify the refugee applicant of the Notice of Extension of the Examination Period for Refugee Status in the form of Annex 13 pursuant to Paragraph 5 of the same Article . <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 제10조(이의신청 절차 등) ① 법 제21조제1항에 따라 난민불인정결정이나 난민인정 취소 또는 철회에 대하여 이의를 신청하려는 사람은 별지 제14호서식의 이의신청서(이하 “이의신청서”라 한다)에 다음 각 호의 서류 및 자료를 첨부하여 청장등에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 영 제9조의3제1항에 따른 전자민원창구를 통하여 접수하는 경우에는 제1호의 서류를 첨부하지 않는다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2021. 7. 29.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Procedures for Objection, etc.) ①Any person who intends to file an objection against a decision denying refugee status or the cancellation or withdrawal of refugee recognition pursuant to Article 21 , Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an objection form in Annex No. 14 (hereinafter referred to as the “objection form”) to the Commissioner, etc., attaching the documents and materials specified in each of the following subparagraphs. However, in the case of receipt through the electronic civil complaint window pursuant to Article 9-3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree , the document specified in Subparagraph 1 shall not be attached. <Amended May 15, 2018; July 29, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 여권 또는 외국인등록증. 다만, 이를 첨부할 수 없는 경우에는 그 사유서
rows.text_en: 1. Passport or Alien Registration Card. However, if these cannot be attached, a statement of reasons must be provided.

rows.source_ko: 2. 이의신청 사유를 소명하는 자료
rows.text_en: 2. Materials substantiating the grounds for the objection

rows.source_ko: 3. 법정대리인의 자격을 증명하는 서류(법정대리인이 이의신청을 대리하는 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 3. Documents proving the qualifications of the legal representative (applicable only when the legal representative is acting on behalf of the applicant in filing an objection)

rows.source_ko: ② 청장등은 제1항에 따라 이의신청서를 제출받은 때에는 영 제9조의2에 따라 즉시 신청자에게 별지 제14호의2서식의 이의신청 접수증을 발급하고, 그 이의신청서를 지체 없이 법무부장관에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② When the Commissioner, etc. receives an objection form pursuant to Paragraph 1, they shall immediately issue an objection receipt in the form of Annex 14-2 to the applicant pursuant to Article 9-2 of the Enforcement Decree , and forward said objection form to the Minister of Justice without delay. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제11조제3항의 이의신청 기각ㆍ각하결정통지서는 별지 제15호서식에 따른다. <개정 2021. 7. 29.>
rows.text_en: ③ The notice of decision to dismiss or reject an objection under Article 11, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 15 of the Attached Form . <Amended July 29, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ④ 법무부장관이 법 제21조제7항 단서에 따라 이의신청 심사기간을 연장하였을 때에는 같은 조 제8항에 따라 별지 제16호서식의 이의신청 심사기간 연장 통지서를 이의신청을 한 사람에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Justice extends the period for reviewing an objection pursuant to the proviso of Article 21, Paragraph 7 of the Act , he/she shall notify the person who filed the objection of the extension of the period for reviewing an objection in accordance with Paragraph 8 of the same Article using the notice of extension of the period for reviewing an objection in the form of Annex 16 .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(난민인정취소ㆍ철회 통지서) 법 제22조제3항의 난민인정취소ㆍ철회통지서는 별지 제17호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Notice of Cancellation or Withdrawal of Refugee Status) The notice of cancellation or withdrawal of refugee status under Article 22, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 17 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제12조(난민위원회의 구성 및 운영 등) ① 법 제25조에 따른 난민위원회(이하 “위원회”라 한다)의 위원장(이하 “위원장”이라 한다)은 위원회를 대표하고 위원회의 업무를 총괄한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Composition and Operation of the Refugee Committee, etc.) ① The Chairperson (hereinafter referred to as the “Chairperson”) of the Refugee Committee pursuant to Article 25 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Committee”) represents the Committee and oversees the Committee’s affairs.

rows.source_ko: ② 위원장이 부득이한 사유로 직무를 수행할 수 없을 때에는 법무부장관이 지명하는 위원이 그 직무를 대행한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Chairperson is unable to perform their duties due to unavoidable circumstances, a member designated by the Minister of Justice shall perform the duties on their behalf.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법무부장관은 위원회의 위원이 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 해임하거나 위촉을 해제할 수 있다. <개정 2023. 2. 27., 2024. 12. 3.>
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Justice may dismiss or revoke the appointment of a member of the Committee if the member falls under any of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Feb. 27, 2023; Dec. 3, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 1. 심신쇠약 등으로 직무수행이 불가능하거나 현저히 곤란하다고 인정되는 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Cases where it is recognized that performing duties is impossible or significantly difficult due to physical or mental weakness, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 직무 태만, 품위 손상, 그 밖의 사유로 인하여 위원으로서 직무를 수행하기에 적합하지 아니하다고 인정되는 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Cases where a member is deemed unfit to perform their duties due to negligence of duty, damage to reputation, or other reasons.

rows.source_ko: 3. 법 제17조의 금지사항을 위반한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. In the case of violating the prohibitions under Article 17 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 제12조의2제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는데도 불구하고 회피하지 않은 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Cases where avoidance is not performed despite falling under any of the subparagraphs of Article 12-2, Paragraph 1

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항의 해임 또는 위촉 해제로 인하여 새로 임명되거나 위촉된 위원의 임기는 전임 위원의 남은 임기로 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The term of office of a member newly appointed or commissioned due to the dismissal or release from commission under Paragraph 3 shall be the remaining term of the predecessor.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 법 제25조제3항에 따라 분과위원회를 두는 경우 분과위원회 위원장은 법무부장관이 각 분과위원회의 위원 중에서 지명하고, 위원장의 직무에 관하여는 제1항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ In cases where a subcommittee is established pursuant to Article 25, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the chairperson of the subcommittee shall be designated by the Minister of Justice from among the members of each subcommittee, and Paragraph 1 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the duties of the chairperson.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 제1항부터 제5항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 위원회의 운영 및 분과위원회 구성ㆍ운영 등에 필요한 사항은 법무부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 5, matters necessary for the operation of the Committee and the composition and operation of subcommittees shall be determined by the Minister of Justice .

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(위원의 제척과 회피) ① 위원회(분과위원회를 포함한다)의 위원(이하 “위원”이라 한다)은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 경우에는 그 안건의 심의ㆍ의결에서 제척(除斥)된다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Disqualification and Recusal of Members) ① A member of the Committee (including subcommittees) (hereinafter referred to as “member”) shall be disqualified from deliberating and voting on an agenda item in any of the following cases:

rows.source_ko: 1. 위원 또는 위원이 속하거나 이의신청일 전 최근 5년 이내에 속하였던 법인ㆍ단체ㆍ법률사무소가 해당 안건에 관하여 이의신청인의 대리인 또는 법률상담이나 조언 등 조력을 제공하는 자(이하 “대리인등”이라 한다)이거나 대리인등이었던 경우
rows.text_en: 1. Where a member, or a corporation, organization, or law firm to which the member belongs or to which the member belonged within the last five years prior to the date of the objection, is or was an agent, etc. of the objector or a person providing assistance such as legal consultation or advice regarding the relevant matter (hereinafter referred to as “agent, etc.”).

rows.source_ko: 2. 위원이 이의신청인 또는 그 대리인등과 「민법」 제777조에 따른 친족이거나 친족이었던 경우
rows.text_en: 2. Where a member is or was a relative of the objector or their representative, etc., pursuant to Article 777 of the Civil Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 위원이 해당 안건에 대하여 증언, 진술, 자문, 연구, 용역 또는 감정을 한 경우
rows.text_en: 3. Where a member has testified, made a statement, provided advice, conducted research, performed services, or provided an expert opinion regarding the relevant matter.

rows.source_ko: 4. 위원 또는 위원이 속하거나 이의신청일 전 최근 5년 이내에 속하였던 법인ㆍ단체ㆍ법률사무소가 해당 안건의 대상이 된 처분에 관여하거나 관여하였던 경우
rows.text_en: 4. Where a member, or a corporation, organization, or law firm to which the member belongs or to which the member belonged within the last five years prior to the date of the objection, was or is involved in the disposition that is the subject of the case.

rows.source_ko: ② 위원은 제1항 각 호의 사유에 해당하는 경우에는 스스로 해당 안건의 심의ㆍ의결에서 회피(回避)하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If a member falls under any of the reasons in subparagraphs of Paragraph 1, the member shall recuse himself/herself from the deliberation and resolution of the relevant matter.
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 27, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의3(자문위원) ① 위원장은 영 제10조제2항에 따라 심의사항에 대한 의견을 듣기 위하여 심의사항과 관련하여 경험이나 지식이 풍부한 사람을 자문위원으로 위촉할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-3 (Advisory Members) ① The Chairpersonmay appoint persons with extensive experience or knowledge regarding matters under deliberation as advisory members in order to hear opinions on matters under deliberation pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree .

rows.source_ko: ② 자문위원은 위원회의 요청에 따라 심의사항에 대하여 위원회의 회의에 출석하여 의견을 진술하거나 서면으로 의견을 제출할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Advisory members may attend a meeting of the Committee to state their opinions on matters under deliberation or submit their opinions in writing at the request of the Committee.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 의견을 진술하거나 제출한 자문위원에게는 예산의 범위에서 수당과 그 밖에 필요한 경비를 지급할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ Advisory committee members who state or submit opinions pursuant to Paragraph 2 may be paid allowances and other necessary expenses within the limits of the budget.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 자문위원의 위촉 및 자문 절차 등에 필요한 사항은 법무부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, matters necessary for the appointment of advisory members and advisory procedures, etc. shall be determined by the Minister of Justice .
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 27, 2023]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의4(의견 청취) ① 법무부장관은 영 제10조제2항에 따라 위원회가 이의신청인 또는 그 밖의 관계인을 회의에 출석시켜 진술하게 하려는 경우에는 위원회 회의 개최일 7일 전까지 출석 일시 및 장소를 이의신청인(그 대리인을 포함한다. 이하 이 조에서 같다) 또는 그 밖의 관계인에게 통지하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-4 (Hearing of Opinions) ① In accordance with Article 10, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, if the Minister of Justiceintends for the Committee to have an objector or other relevant persons attend a meeting and make a statement, he/she shall notify the objector (including their representative; hereinafter the same applies in this Article) or other relevant persons of the time and place of attendance at least 7 days prior to the date of the Committee meeting.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항의 통지를 받은 이의신청인 또는 그 밖의 관계인은 위원회의 회의에 출석할 수 없는 부득이한 사유가 있는 경우에는 미리 서면(전자문서를 포함한다)으로 의견을 진술할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If an objector or other interested party who has received the notice under Paragraph 1 has unavoidable reasons for being unable to attend the meeting of the Committee, they may state their opinion in writing (including electronic documents) in advance.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에서 규정한 사항 외에 이의신청인 또는 그 밖의 관계인의 의견 청취에 필요한 사항은 법무부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, matters necessary for hearing the opinions of the objector or other interested parties shall be determined by the Minister of Justice .
[This Article Newly Inserted Feb. 27, 2023]
Article 12-5 Deleted <December 3, 2024>

rows.source_ko: 제13조(교육비 지원 추천 절차) ① 영 제13조제2항에 따른 교육비 지원 추천을 받으려는 난민인정자나 그 자녀는 별지 제18호서식의 교육비 지원 추천 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 청장ㆍ사무소장이나 출장소장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Procedure for Recommendation for Educational Expense Support) ①A recognized refugee or their child who wishes to receive a recommendation for educational expense support pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for recommendation for educational expense support in the form of Annex 18, attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Commissioner, the Head of the Office, or the Head of the Branch Office. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: 1. 입학(재학) 증명서 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of the Certificate of Admission (Enrollment)

rows.source_ko: 2. 가족관계를 증명할 수 있는 서류 1부(추천을 받으려는 사람이 난민인정자의 자녀인 경우만 해당한다)
rows.text_en: 2. One copy of documents proving family relationship (applicable only if the person seeking recommendation is the child of a recognized refugee)

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청서를 받은 청장ㆍ사무소장 또는 출장소장은 지원 필요 여부에 대한 의견을 붙여 해당 서류를 지체 없이 법무부장관에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner, Head of Office, or Head of Branch Office who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall send the relevant documents to the Minister of Justice without delay, attaching an opinion on whether support is necessary. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 교육비 지원 추천 신청을 받은 법무부장관은 「초ㆍ중등교육법」 제60조의4에 따른 교육비 지원이 필요하다고 인정되면 신청인에게 별지 제19호서식의 교육비 지원 추천서를 발급하고, 그 결과를 교육부장관에게 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Justice who receives an application for recommendation for educational expense support pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall, if it is deemed necessary to provide educational expense support pursuant to Article 60-4 of the Elementary and Secondary Education Act, issue a recommendation letter for educational expense support in the form of Annex 19 to the applicant and notify the Minister of Education of the result.

rows.source_ko: 제14조(직업훈련 추천 절차) ① 영 제15조에 따른 직업훈련 추천을 받으려는 난민인정자는 별지 제20호서식의 직업훈련 추천 신청서를 청장ㆍ사무소장이나 출장소장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Procedure for Recommendation for Vocational Training) ①A recognized refugee who wishes to receive a recommendation for vocational training pursuant to Article 15 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for recommendation for vocational training in the form of Annex 20 to the Commissioner, the head of the office, or the head of the branch office. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청서를 받은 청장ㆍ사무소장 또는 출장소장은 지원 필요 여부에 대한 의견을 붙여 해당 서류를 지체 없이 법무부장관에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner, Head of Office, or Head of Branch Office who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall send the relevant documents to the Minister of Justice without delay, attaching an opinion on whether support is necessary. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 직업훈련 추천 신청을 받은 법무부장관은 「국민 평생 직업능력 개발법」 제12조에 따른 직업능력개발훈련이 필요하다고 인정되면 신청인에게 별지 제21호서식의 직업훈련 추천서를 발급하고, 그 결과를 고용노동부장관에게 통보하여야 한다. <개정 2023. 2. 27.>
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application for a recommendation for vocational training pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Justice shall, if deemed necessary for vocational competency development training under Article 12 of the National Act on the Development of Lifelong Vocational Competencies, issue a recommendation letter for vocational training in the form of Annex 21 to the applicant and notify the Minister of Employment and Labor of the results. <Amended Feb. 27, 2023>

rows.source_ko: 제15조(생계비 지원 절차 등) ① 법 제40조제1항에 따른 생계비 등을 지원받으려는 난민신청자는 별지 제22호서식의 생계비 등 지원신청서를 청장ㆍ사무소장ㆍ출장소장 또는 출입국ㆍ외국인지원센터의 장에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Procedures for Support for Living Expenses, etc.) ①A refugee applicant who wishes to receive support for living expenses, etc. pursuant to Article 40, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for support for living expenses, etc. in the form of Annex No. 22 to the Commissioner, the head of a regional office, the head of a branch office, or the head of an Immigration and Foreigner Support Center. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청서를 받은 청장ㆍ사무소장ㆍ출장소장 또는 출입국ㆍ외국인지원센터의 장은 지원 필요 여부에 대한 의견을 붙여 해당 서류를 지체 없이 법무부장관에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner, Head of Office, Head of Branch Office, or Head of Immigration and Foreigner Support Center who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall send the relevant documents to the Minister of Justice without delay, attaching an opinion on whether support is necessary. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 생계비 등의 지원 신청을 받은 법무부장관은 지체 없이 생계비 등의 지원 여부를 심사하고, 그 결과를 난민신청자에게 알려 주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Justice who receives an application for support for living expenses, etc. pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall review whether to provide such support without delay and notify the refugee applicant of the result.

rows.source_ko: 제16조(주거시설 이용 절차) ① 영 제19조에 따라 주거시설을 이용하려는 사람은 별지 제23호서식의 주거시설 이용신청서에 가족관계를 입증할 수 있는 서류(신청인의 배우자나 미성년 자녀가 함께 이용하고자 하는 경우만 해당한다)를 첨부하여 청장, 사무소장, 출장소장 또는 주거시설의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. 다만, 난민지원시설에 설치된 주거시설을 이용하려는 경우에는 제17조에 따른다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Procedure for Use of Residential Facilities) ①A person who intends to use residential facilities pursuant to Article 19 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for the use of residential facilities in the form of Annex 23, attached with documents proving family relations (only applicable if the applicant's spouse or minor children wish to use the facilities together), to the Commissioner, the head of the office, the head of the branch office, or the head of the residential facility. However, in the case of intending to use residential facilities installed in refugee support facilities, Article 17 shall apply. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청서를 받은 청장, 사무소장, 출장소장 또는 주거시설의 장은 주거시설 이용 필요 여부에 대한 의견을 붙여 해당 서류를 법무부장관에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15.>
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner, Head of Office, Head of Branch Office, or Head of Residential Facility who receives an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall send the relevant documents to the Minister of Justice, attaching an opinion on whether the use of the residential facility is necessary. <Amended May 15, 2018>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 주거시설의 이용 신청을 받은 법무부장관은 지체 없이 주거시설 이용 여부 및 이용기간을 결정하고, 그 결과를 신청인에게 알려 주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving an application for the use of a residential facility pursuant to Paragraph 2, the Minister of Justice shall determine whether to allow the use of the residential facility and the period of use without delay, and notify the applicant of the result.

rows.source_ko: 제16조의2(의료 지원 절차) ① 법 제42조 및 영 제20조제1항에 따라 건강검진 등 의료 지원을 받으려는 난민신청자는 별지 제23호의2서식의 의료 지원 신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 청장ㆍ사무소장ㆍ출장소장 또는 외국인보호소장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 16-2 (Medical Support Procedure) ①A refugee applicant who wishes to receive medical support, such as a health examination, pursuant to Article 42 of the Act and Article 20 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, must submit a medical support application form in Annex 23-2, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Commissioner, Head of Office, Head of Branch Office, or Head of Foreigner Detention Center.

rows.source_ko: 1. 병원진단서 또는 의사소견서 1부
rows.text_en: 1. One copy of a hospital diagnosis certificate or doctor's opinion

rows.source_ko: 2. 의료비내역서
rows.text_en: 2. Medical Expense Statement

rows.source_ko: ② 청장ㆍ사무소장ㆍ출장소장 또는 외국인보호소장은 제1항에 따라 의료 지원 신청서를 제출받으면 지체 없이 의료 지원 여부를 심사하고, 그 결과를 난민신청자에게 알려 주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving an application for medical assistance pursuant to Paragraph 1, the Commissioner, the head of the office, the head of the branch office, or the head of the foreigner detention center shall review whether to provide medical assistance without delay and notify the refugee applicant of the result.
[This Article Newly Inserted Dec. 31, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제17조(난민지원시설 이용 절차) ① 영 제23조에 따라 난민지원시설을 이용하려는 사람은 별지 제24호의 난민지원시설 이용신청서에 가족관계를 입증할 수 있는 서류(신청인의 배우자나 미성년 자녀가 함께 이용하고자 하는 경우만 해당한다)를 첨부하여 청장, 사무소장, 출장소장 또는 출입국ㆍ외국인지원센터의 장에게 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Procedure for Use of Refugee Support Facilities) ① A person who intends to use refugee support facilities pursuant to Article 23 of the Enforcement Decree shall submit an application for the use of refugee support facilities (Form No. 24 of the Appendix) to the Commissioner, the Head of a Regional Office, the Head of a Branch Office, or the Head of an Immigration and Foreigner Support Center, attaching documents proving family relations (only applicable if the applicant's spouse or minor children wish to use the facilities together). <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 신청서를 제출받은 청장, 사무소장 또는 출장소장은 난민지원시설 이용 필요 여부에 대한 의견을 붙여 해당 서류를 출입국ㆍ외국인지원센터의 장에게 보내야 한다. <개정 2018. 5. 15., 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ② The Commissioner, the head of the office, or the head of the branch office who has received an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall send the relevant documents to the head of the Immigration and Foreigner Support Center, attaching an opinion on whether the use of refugee support facilities is necessary. <Amended May 15, 2018; December 31, 2019>

rows.source_ko: ③ 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 난민지원시설의 이용 신청을 받은 출입국ㆍ외국인지원센터의 장은 지체 없이 난민지원시설의 이용 여부 및 이용기간을 결정하고, 그 결과를 신청인에게 알려 주어야 한다. <개정 2019. 12. 31.>
rows.text_en: ③ The head of the Immigration and Foreigner Support Center who receives an application for the use of refugee support facilities pursuant to Paragraphs 1 and 2 shall determine without delay whether to allow the use of the refugee support facilities and the period of use, and notify the applicant of the result. <Amended Dec. 31, 2019>
ADDENDA <Ministry of Justice Decree No. 795, June 28, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2013년 7월 1일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on July 1, 2013.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 출입국관리법 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Immigration Control Act is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제6장의2 제목 “난민의 인정등”을 “난민여행증명서 발급 등”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title of Chapter 6-2, “Recognition of Refugees, etc.,” shall be changed to “Issuance of Refugee Travel Certificates, etc.”

rows.source_ko: 제6장의2제1절(제67조의2부터 제67조의6까지)을 삭제한다.
rows.text_en: Section 1 of Chapter 6-2 (Articles 67-2 through 67-6) is deleted.

rows.source_ko: 제67조의9 앞의 “제2절 난민인정증명서 발급등”을 삭제한다.
rows.text_en: Delete “Section 2 Issuance of Refugee Recognition Certificate, etc.” preceding Article 67-9.

rows.source_ko: 제67조의13을 삭제한다.
rows.text_en: Article 67-13 is deleted.

rows.source_ko: 제78조제3항 중 “법 제30조제1항, 제76조의8제3항, 제89조에 따른 권한”을 “법 제30조제1항 및 제89조에 따른 권한”으로 하고, 같은 조 제4항을 삭제하며, 같은 조 제5항 중 “제23조부터 제25조까지, 제30조, 제76조의2, 제76조의3 및 제76조의8제2항ㆍ제3항에 따른 허가 등을 하려는 경우에는 제1항부터 제4항까지의 규정에도 불구하고”를 “제23조부터 제25조까지 및 제30조에 따른 허가 등을 하려는 경우에는 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에도 불구하고”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 78, Paragraph 3, “authority pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 1, Article 76-8, Paragraph 3, and Article 89 of the Act” shall be changed to “authority pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 1 and Article 89 of the Act”, Paragraph 4 of the same Article shall be deleted, and in Paragraph 5 of the same Article, “notwithstanding the provisions of Paragraphs 1 through 4 in cases where permission, etc. is to be granted pursuant to Articles 23 through 25, Article 30, Article 76-2, Article 76-3 and Article 76-8, Paragraphs 2 and 3” shall be changed to “notwithstanding the provisions of Paragraphs 1 through 3 in cases where permission, etc. is to be granted pursuant to Articles 23 through 25 and Article 30”.

rows.source_ko: 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다. 다만, 제10조제1항 및 별지 제14호서식의 개정규정은 2022년 1월 1일부터 시행한다.

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 공포한 날부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This Rule shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(위원의 해임ㆍ해촉 및 제척ㆍ회피에 관한 적용례) 제12조제3항제4호 및 제12조의2의 개정규정은 이 규칙 시행 이후 소집되는 위원회의 회의부터 적용한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Applicability to Dismissal, Removal, Exclusion, and Avoidance of Members)  The amended provisions of Article 12, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 4 and Article 12-2 shall apply to meetings of the Committee convened after the enforcement of this Rule.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(난민조사관 요건에 관한 경과조치) ① 이 규칙 시행 당시 난민조사관의 직위에서 근무하는 사람은 제12조의5제2항의 개정규정에 따른 요건을 갖춘 난민조사관으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Transitional Measures Concerning Qualifications for Refugee Investigators)  ① Any person serving in the position of refugee investigator at the time of the enforcement of this Rule shall be deemed a refugee investigator who meets the requirements pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 12-5, Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에도 불구하고 이 규칙 시행 당시 난민조사관의 직위에서 근무하는 사람(난민조사관의 직위에서 근무한 경력이 6개월 미만인 사람으로 한정한다)이 난민조사관으로 임명될 당시 제12조의5제2항의 개정규정에 따른 요건을 갖추지 못한 경우에는 이 규칙 시행 후 1년 이내에 같은 항 제2호가목의 개정규정에 따른 교육을 이수하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Notwithstanding Paragraph 1, if a person serving in the position of refugee investigator at the time of enforcement of this rule (limited to those with less than 6 months of experience in the position of refugee investigator) did not meet the requirements under the amended provisions of Paragraph 2 of Article 12-5 at the time of appointment as a refugee investigator, they must complete the education under the amended provisions of Subparagraph 2(a) of the same paragraph within one year after enforcement of this rule.
ADDENDA <Ministry of Justice Decree No. 1068, Dec. 27, 2023>
